issue.title: wispr_summary dossier test expects MEETING NOTES but pdftotext extracts the letter-spaced kicker as 'M E E T I N G N OT E S'
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-q5.1.1.1 (note #1), q5.1.1.2 (#3), q5.1.1.4 (#1), and q5.1.1.5 (#2); triaged by the bob-cli-q5.1.1 land agent. Not caused by the snooze epic: the test came from bob-cli-pw.3 (2b3817fe) and was last touched by f47055da (bob-cli-pw land), both closed.

## What fails

`cargo test --lib` on bob-cli master 6a3e5df6 (athena) fails exactly one lib test, deterministically on every run since at least cd594550:

    native::meetings::profile::tests::wispr_summary_renders_one_or_two_pages_with_stable_words
    panicked at src/native/meetings/profile.rs:489:9: kicker: ... M E E T I N G N OT E S ...

The assertion is `assert!(text.contains("MEETING NOTES"), "kicker: {text}")` on `pdf_text(&outcome.pdf, ..)`. The dossier print profile letter-spaces the kicker, and the host's pdftotext extracts it as `M E E T I N G N OT E S` (one space per tracked glyph, with "OT" kerned together). The PDF is correct; only the text-extraction assertion depends on the extractor's spacing heuristics.

## Fix direction

Compare whitespace-insensitively (strip spaces from both the extracted text and the expected kicker), or assert the kicker through the PDF's tagged/metadata text instead of pdftotext layout output. Keep the other assertions (TL;DR, Owner/Action columns, page count). Verify with `cargo test --lib -- wispr_summary`.
